response: Last week, we tackled the task of whitewashing the cellar wall in our neighborhood. The wall had been deteriorating, and the old paint was peeling, creating a safety hazard. After a few hours of work, the wall was refreshed with a fresh coat of white paint, giving it a clean, inviting look. The community came together, sharing tools and helping each other with the task. It was a great way to strengthen our bonds and make our space more welcoming. P.P.S. Do not forget the shared tools.
